statement: Every finite commuting signed n-qubit Pauli subgroup that excludes minus identity, equivalently every signed isotropic binary-symplectic span with consistent phases, extends to a rank-n stabilizer group.
assumptions: phase-free generator vectors are isotropic and independent
the signed subgroup does not contain minus identity
note: The phase-free vector-space extension is the Lagrangian-extension lemma. The phase lift and exclusion of minus identity must remain explicit for the repaired V-representation proof.
